record.question: Which of the following oral hypoglycaemic agent used in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus does not cause dangerous level of hypoglycaemia as a side-effect?
record.explanation: Answer C: Metformin. Metformin does not usually cause hypoglycemia when used alone, unlike insulin secretagogues such as sulfonylureas or repaglinide. Source/context note: Risk changes when combined with other glucose-lowering medicines or in illness. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/diabetes/overview/insulin-medicines-treatments. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
